name: Titi – Offline Walkie Talkie
subtitle: Group radio. No signal needed
promotionalText: Talk to your group anywhere: phone to phone over Bluetooth, or through the internet. Hold to talk, even from the Lock Screen. No account. End-to-end encrypted.
description:
Titi turns your iPhone into a private group radio for the places where the network gives up: mountains, ski slopes, festivals, boats, basements, abroad without roaming.

TALK WITHOUT SIGNAL
• iPhones and Android phones nearby find each other over Bluetooth. No internet, no account.
• Messages hop from phone to phone through other members, so range grows with your group.
• When internet is there, Titi also talks through its relay for a longer, steadier link, and switches back when it drops.

PUSH TO TALK, DONE RIGHT
• One big Talk button. Hold to speak, release to listen.
• Built on Apple's Push to Talk: talk and hear your group from the Lock Screen, with the system Push to Talk controls.
• Open mic mode for hands-free conversation in small groups.
• You always see who is talking and how they reach you: Bluetooth, relay, or hops through other phones.

GROUP CHAT THAT KEEPS UP
• Reply, react, edit, delete for everyone, forward and @mention.
• Search the whole conversation, Romanian diacritics included.
• SOS with your location reaches everyone in range at once.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Voice and messages are end-to-end encrypted (Noise + ChaCha20-Poly1305) with keys only your group holds.
• No account, no phone number, no ads, no analytics. The relay forwards encrypted traffic and stores nothing.
• Invite people with three words and two digits you can say out loud, a QR code, or a link. Codes change every 10 minutes.
• Block a member, report abuse, and keep the optional word filter on.

WORKS WITH EVERYONE
• Talks to Titi on Android, Windows and the web, so the whole group can join, whatever they carry.

On iPhone, version 0.1.0 connects over Bluetooth and the internet. Same-Wi-Fi discovery is coming in a later update.

Titi is free and open source (AGPL-3.0). Made in Romania.
whatsNew:
First release on iPhone.

• Hold-to-talk group voice over Bluetooth or the internet.
• Apple Push to Talk: talk and listen from the Lock Screen.
• Group chat with reply, reactions, edit, delete for everyone, mentions and search.
• Join by three words + two digits, QR code or link.
• SOS with location.
• Block, report and an optional word filter.
